label: behavioural_bout
description: Root of the classification tree used in ActivInsights 24hr behavioural bout analysis.

label: sedentary
description: Sitting or reclining posture (and MET below 1.5).

label: active
description: Active physical behaviour (light, moderate and vigorous MET).

label: slow_walk
description: Walking slower than median cadence (nominally 70 steps per minute).

label: fast_walk
description: Walking faster than median cadence (nominally 70 steps per minute).
